description: This file is a shell script for testing the 'git fsmonitor' functionality, including starting/stopping the fsmonitor daemon, simulating filesystem events, and verifying correct behavior under various scenarios.

methods.name: stop_daemon_delete_repo
methods.description: Stops the fsmonitor daemon in a given repository and deletes it.

methods.name: start_daemon
methods.description: Starts the fsmonitor daemon with optional parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: have_t2_data_event
methods.description: Checks if a Trace2 data event with specified category and key exists in the trace output.

methods.name: verify_implicit_shutdown
methods.description: Verifies that the daemon has shut down implicitly after filesystem events.

methods.name: create_super
methods.description: Creates a superproject repository with some files for testing submodules.

methods.name: create_sub
methods.description: Creates a submodule repository with some files for testing submodule behavior.

methods.name: my_match_and_clean
methods.description: Checks that Git status outputs are consistent with or without fsmonitor for submodules.

methods.name: start_git_in_background
methods.description: Runs a git command in background and waits for it with a watchdog.

methods.name: stop_git
methods.description: Terminates the background git process.

methods.name: stop_watchdog
methods.description: Stops the watchdog process that monitors the background git.

methods.name: clean_up_repo_and_stop_daemon
methods.description: Resets the repository and stops the fsmonitor daemon.

methods.name: edit_files
methods.description: Simulates editing files for filesystem event testing.

methods.name: delete_files
methods.description: Deletes files to simulate filesystem deletions.

methods.name: create_files
methods.description: Creates new files for filesystem event testing.

methods.name: rename_files
methods.description: Renames files to test rename detection.

methods.name: file_to_directory
methods.description: Converts a file to a directory, testing directory change events.

methods.name: directory_to_file
methods.description: Converts a directory to a file, testing file change events.

methods.name: move_directory_contents_deeper
methods.description: Moves directory contents to a deeper path.

methods.name: move_directory_up
methods.description: Moves a deep directory up one level.

methods.name: move_directory
methods.description: Renames a directory.
